allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Ravindra Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 27, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 9, i.e 1 Equity Share for every 9 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 101 per share.

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that our Nomination and Remuneration Committee, at their meeting held on January 10, 2025, has approved the grant of 10,67,301 (Ten Lakh-Sixty Seven Thousand-Three Hundred One) employee stock options to the eligible employees under the  Ravindra Energy Employees Stock Option Scheme 2022  ( REL ESOP Scheme 2022  or  Plan ), out of the shareholders approved limit of 13,67,301 (Thirteen Lakhs Sixty-Seven Thousand Three Hundred One) options
